title: Carve-Out: Which Contracts Move With the Business Unit
scenario_text: Skagen Energy's legal operations team is updating its contract system after a divestiture. Seller "Meridian Power Group, Inc." (EIN 52-7781200) sold its retail electricity book to buyer "Aurora Grid Retail LLC" (EIN 88-4432019) in an asset carve-out closing 2024-05-01. Skagen holds two supply agreements with Meridian: SA-100, a wholesale generation supply contract tied to Meridian's generation fleet, and SA-200, a demand-response services contract that served Meridian's retail customer accounts. The purchase agreement's schedule of assigned contracts (Exhibit C) lists SA-200 among the "Retail Business Assigned Contracts" transferred to Aurora Grid Retail LLC by an assignment-and-assumption agreement effective 2024-05-01, and expressly lists SA-100 among "Excluded Contracts" retained by Meridian. Skagen's Ironclad repository currently shows both contracts still pointing to counterparty "Meridian Power Group, Inc." A vendor-master update also arrived: Aurora Grid Retail LLC provided a new W-9 (EIN 88-4432019), new remit-to, and new banking (routing 026009593, account ending 3310). Meridian's generation entity retains its original EIN and banking. An analyst proposes reassigning both SA-100 and SA-200 to Aurora because "the whole relationship moved to the buyer." Skagen's AP has already received one invoice under SA-100 from Meridian's retained banking and a separate remittance notice referencing SA-200 from Aurora, and the analyst must reconcile both before the next payment run so that neither obligation is paid to the wrong counterparty.
question: How should the two supply agreements be reassigned in the contract and vendor systems?
choices: Reassign both SA-100 and SA-200 to Aurora Grid Retail LLC (EIN 88-4432019), since the divestiture transferred the counterparty relationship to the buyer.
Leave both SA-100 and SA-200 with Meridian Power Group, Inc., since Skagen was not a party to the purchase agreement and asset sales never move third-party contracts.
Reassign only SA-200 to Aurora Grid Retail LLC (EIN 88-4432019) per the Exhibit C assignment, and keep SA-100 with Meridian Power Group, Inc. as an Excluded Contract.
Split each contract in half between Meridian and Aurora because both entities now share the customer base created before the carve-out.
